title: Gurudev
desc: An inspector is faced with a rigid decision when he learns his own father is with the underworld. Where do his loyalties lie?

title: Roti Kapada Aur Makaan
desc: Bharat struggles to navigate family leadership and responsibility after his father's death, confronting personal challenges and emotional turmoil while striving to keep his family united and strong..

title: Judaai
desc: Driven by greed, Kajal urges her honest husband Raj to marry his boss's wealthy daughter Janhvi, but her plan triggers unforeseen consequences that threaten their lives.

title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

title: Ghajini
desc: After a brutal head injury, Sanjay loses the ability to retain memories beyond fifteen minutes. With clues tattooed on his body, he embarks on a relentless quest to find his fiancee's killer.

title: Singham Again
desc: Drawing parallels to the Ramayana, Bajirao Singham leads his team on a daring mission to rescue his wife while facing a powerful and mysterious enemy.

title: Jawaani Jaaneman
desc: Jazz, a carefree 40-year-old casanova in London, has his world turned upside down when Tia, claiming to be his daughter, enters his life and forces him to change.

title: Dhamaal
desc: Roy, Manav, Aditya and Boman chase a hidden treasure in Goa, but as Inspector Kabir gets on their trail, their fun-filled adventure turns into a chaotic race against time.

title: Biwi Ho To Aisi
desc: Suraj secretly marries Shalu, a village belle, defying his domineering mother Kamla. To drive Shalu away, Kamla falsely accuses her of stealing jewellery and money.

title: Nagina (1986)
desc: Rajiv, saved as a child from a snake bite, later marries Rajni. Bhaironath claims she is a snake seeking revenge for her lover, but actually wants her hidden pearl.

title: Nigahen
desc: A snake charmer is in search of a priceless diamond which will bestow him with immense power. However, he discovers that his only hope of locating the diamond is Rajiv and Rajni's daughter Neelam.

title: Dil Dhadakne Do
desc: Kamal and Neelam celebrate their 30th anniversary on a cruise, where family, friends, and unexpected lessons transform their lives and relationships forever.
